_comment: Edit this file to change digest behavior. Commit the change and the next run picks it up.
_focus_comment: Leave subject_focus empty to rotate through focus_rotation daily (by day of year). Set it to one topic to search only that. Topic names must match scripts/topics.py QUERIES; anything else is searched as a plain phrase. An empty string in the rotation is a broad day.
_window_comment: days_back is the OpenAlex publication window. Anything a previous digest wrote up is dropped, so a wide window does not mean repeats. max_per_journal stops one prolific title from filling the run.
